As drawn, J12.A4 ties '+5V' and 'VBUS' together, shorting the mux input to its own output.

anomalies.impact: The TPS2121RUXR power mux is bypassed/defeated: its IN2 (+5V) and OUT (VBUS) become the same node, which is also the USB 5 V supply. When the 12 V barrel jack is connected, the mux drives ~12 V onto this node, forcing 12 V onto the USB 5 V rail and back-powering the host port, while the intended seamless 12 V/5 V switchover is lost. The buck (U8) input 'VBUS' is no longer an arbitrated rail.
